subject: Micro-concession impacts to November committed forecast
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick action: small concession approvals and November commit

Team,

We ran a last-minute sweep of deals slated as "committed" for November and flagged a handful of small-value opportunities where concessions were applied but approvals either weren't recorded in Deal Desk or were pending finance sign-off. These are low ACV (<$25k) deals but they add up when multiple AEs take micro-concessions — the forecast delta is material for this week9s close.

Attached is a compact worksheet (acme-micro-deals-worksheet.xlsx) that lists the impacted rows for ACME-related opportunities that have a concession recorded in SBX but no Deal Desk approval or finance confirmation. Please review the entries assigned to your reps:
- Neha: 3 rows (two 5% concessions, one 12% request)
- Marissa (Deal Desk): quick triage requested
- Ben / Karthik (Finance): we need an explicit call on whether to treat any of these as non-committed until approvals land.

Specific ask: by EOD Wednesday (2026-11-04 23:59 PT) confirm either (A) approvals are in Deal Desk and supporting docs are attached, or (B) mark the row as "hold - adjust forecast" so FP&A can reconcile committed revenue. If we don't hear back, Finance will automatically move any >10% concession deals to pipeline (not committed) for the November close.

Why this matters: the November commit looks tight; losing a few small deals as committed will materially affect our month-over-month attainment reporting and may trigger an oversell call. We want to avoid after-the-fact reclassifications.

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround.

— Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

I pushed it to Marissa this morning.

If Finance needs the $18k deal held out of commit until we get the formal approval, I9m fine with that — it9s borderline for the rep9s Q. However, if there9s any way to expedite Deal Desk approval for this one (it9s urgent for the AE and the buyer is expecting November start), please advise.

I attached the SOWs we have; the pending row has an email thread with the customer and a draft DocuSign that hasn9t been completed.

Thanks,

Folks,

I reviewed the three rows for ACME in the worksheet. Status: two fully approved (both SOWs signed, concessions <=7%). The 12% request (ACME expansion) is a policy exception and needs VP approval per concession matrix — I flagged the request and routed to the VP queue this morning (ticket DD-2026-447).

Short timeline: VP decision typically within 24-48 hours if the business justification is solid. If VP approves, Deal Desk will perform a retroactive approval entry and upload the signed DocuSign. If VP denies, we should follow Vanessa9s guidance and move the deal to pipeline for forecasting.

Action items:
- Neha: attach the buyer9s email confirming start date + acceptance (helps the VP).
- Neha: confirm whether ACME will sign DocuSign before 11/06 close (salesforce deadline).
- Vanessa / Finance: if you prefer not to wait for the VP, tell us to mark it "hold - not committed" and we will update HubSpot accordingly.

Marissa

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>

Date: Sun, 08 Nov 2026 10:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick action: small concession approvals and November commit

Team,

Appreciate the triage. Per Vanessa9s original ask and after reviewing the Deal Desk notes (DD-2026-447) + the attached SOWs, Finance is taking the conservative path for the month close:

Decision (effective immediately):
- Treat the 12% ACME expansion as NOT committed for November unless we receive VP approval and completed DocuSign by EOD Tuesday 2026-11-10 23:59 PT.
- The two smaller deals (approved and signed) remain committed and will be left in November numbers.

Reasoning: the 12% concession exceeds the standard approval band and the risk of a post-close reclassification is higher than the revenue impact of holding the row. We will reconcile on the November close deck and, should VP approve later, we will include it in December adjustments with full audit notes.

Next steps:
- Neha: update the HubSpot deal stage to "Hold - pending approval" and add the VP ticket number (DD-2026-447).
- Marissa: mark Deal Desk record accordingly so Deal Desk and Finance can find the audit trail.
- Ben: please update the committed forecast sheet to reflect the removal of the $18k expansion from November commit (acme-micro-deals-worksheet.xlsx v2).

Thanks all for the quick responses — this approach will keep our close accurate and avoid downstream restatements.

Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Director, FP&A
Redwood Inference
